<style>
/* GilaClick About — the site supplies the licensed custom font named peyda. */
.ga-page{--ink:#06271f;--green:#0b4435;--neon:#19c58b;--lime:#a3f451;--paper:#f0fbf6;--text:#172b25;--muted:#64756e;--wrap:1268px;--gutter:clamp(20px,4vw,40px);--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);direction:rtl;text-align:right;isolation:isolate;background:#fff;color:var(--text);font-family:peyda;font-size:16px;line-height:1.9;letter-spacing:normal}

.ga-page .elementor-button .elementor-button-text{color:inherit!important}

.ga-page :focus-visible{outline:3px solid #0b6047;outline-offset:4px}.ga-page .ga-dark :focus-visible,.ga-page .ga-header :focus-visible{outline-color:#19c58b}

.ga-page .ga-header-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex:none;width:auto}.ga-page.ga-page .ga-header .ga-icon-button .elementor-button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:43px;height:43px;padding:0;border:1px solid rgba(6,39,31,.13);border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#06271f;fill:#06271f}

.ga-page .ga-icon-button .elementor-button-content-wrapper,.ga-page .ga-icon-button .elementor-button-icon{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;line-height:1}.ga-page .ga-icon-button svg{width:17px;height:17px;fill:currentColor}.ga-page .ga-icon-button .fa,.ga-page .ga-icon-button .fas{font-family:'Font Awesome 5 Free'!important;font-weight:900}.ga-page .ga-icon-button .far{font-family:'Font Awesome 5 Free'!important;font-weight:400}

.ga-page .ga-footer{background:#06271f;color:#c5dbce}.ga-page .ga-footer-inner{display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding:26px 0}.ga-page .ga-footer-brand{font-weight:900;color:#fff;font-size:17px}.ga-page .ga-footer-note{font-size:12px}

.ga-page .ga-h1 .elementor-heading-title{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(38px,4.05vw,61px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.52;letter-spacing:-.03em}.ga-page .ga-h1 .ga-accent{color:#a3f451}.ga-page .ga-h2 .elementor-heading-title{font-size:clamp(29px,3vw,43px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ga-page .ga-h3 .elementor-heading-title{font-size:clamp(18px,1.5vw,21px);font-weight:850;line-height:1.75}
.ga-page .ga-body .elementor-heading-title{color:#64756e;font-size:15.5px;font-weight:450;line-height:2.15}.ga-page .ga-dark .ga-body .elementor-heading-title{color:#c0d8ce}.ga-page .ga-small .elementor-heading-title{font-size:13px;line-height:1.85}
.ga-page .ga-button .elementor-button{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;min-height:54px;padding:13px 22px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;background:#a3f451;color:#06271f;font-size:14px;font-weight:850;line-height:1.5;transition:background-color .25s,color .25s,border-color .25s,transform .3s var(--ease),box-shadow .3s}
.ga-page .ga-button .elementor-button::after{content:'←';font:400 21px/1 peyda;transition:transform .25s}.ga-page .ga-button .elementor-button:hover,.ga-page .ga-button .elementor-button:focus-visible{background:#b8f779;color:#06271f;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(163,244,81,.22);transform:translateY(-3px)}.ga-page .ga-button .elementor-button:hover::after{transform:translateX(-5px)}
.ga-page .ga-button .elementor-button-content-wrapper{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.ga-page .ga-button-outline .elementor-button{border-color:rgba(205,239,219,.35);background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);color:#f2fbf5}.ga-page .ga-button-outline .elementor-button:hover,.ga-page .ga-button-outline .elementor-button:focus-visible{background:#0b4435;color:#fff;border-color:#19c58b}
.ga-page .ga-heading-stack{gap:14px;max-width:720px}.ga-page .ga-copy{gap:20px}.ga-page .ga-copy .ga-body{max-width:610px}.ga-page .ga-dark{color:#fff}.ga-page .ga-section[id]{scroll-margin-top:var(--ga-scroll-offset,110px)}
/* Hero: multilayer instrument, original vector drawing, optical grid and circuit branches. */
.ga-page .ga-hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:#fff;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 26% 48%,rgba(15,110,77,.34),transparent 46%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 83% 8%,rgba(25,197,139,.08),transparent 38%),#06271f}
.ga-page .ga-hero::before,.ga-page .ga-vision::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(47,204,145,.25) .8px,transparent .8px);background-size:25px 25px;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000,transparent 90%);opacity:.46;pointer-events:none}
.ga-page .ga-hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-18%;bottom:-390px;width:760px;height:760px;border:1px solid rgba(25,197,139,.1);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 80px rgba(25,197,139,.014),0 0 0 160px rgba(25,197,139,.012);pointer-events:none}

.ga-page .ga-hero-copy{position:relative;z-index:3;align-items:flex-start;gap:23px}.ga-page .ga-hero-copy .ga-body{max-width:625px}.ga-page .ga-hero-copy .ga-body .elementor-heading-title{font-size:16px;line-height:2.2}.ga-page .ga-hero-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:8px;width:max-content;max-width:100%}
.ga-page .ga-hero-art{position:relative;width:min(100%,650px);justify-self:center;aspect-ratio:1/1}.ga-page .ga-hero-depth{width:100%;height:100%;transform:translate3d(calc(var(--ga-pointer-x,0) * -10px),calc(var(--ga-scroll,0px) + var(--ga-pointer-y,0) * -8px),0);transition:transform .32s ease-out;will-change:transform}.ga-page .ga-hero-svg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.ga-page .ga-hero-caption{position:absolute;bottom:10%;right:4%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:9px 13px;border:1px solid rgba(25,197,139,.32);background:rgba(6,39,31,.78);color:#cbe4d6;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}.ga-page .ga-hero-caption::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:#a3f451;box-shadow:0 0 12px #a3f451}
.ga-page :is(.ga-ring-one,.ga-ring-two,.ga-ring-three){transform-box:view-box;transform-origin:350px 340px}.ga-page .ga-orbit-light{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(163,244,81,.65))}.ga-page .ga-pulse{fill:#a3f451;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #a3f451);offset-rotate:0deg}
/* Introduction is an editorial two-column composition, not a card. */
.ga-page .ga-intro{background:#f0fbf6}.ga-page .ga-intro-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.08fr) minmax(0,.92fr);gap:clamp(38px,7vw,120px);align-items:center}.ga-page .ga-intro-copy{gap:20px}.ga-page .ga-intro-copy .ga-h2{max-width:560px}.ga-page .ga-intro-art{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:510px;justify-self:center;aspect-ratio:1.12}.ga-page .ga-intro-art svg{width:100%;height:100%}
/* The three stories feed one living core; the information is not three cards. */
.ga-page .ga-activities{color:#fff;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 25% 50%,rgba(16,111,79,.22),transparent 48%),#092f26}.ga-page .ga-activities::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(25,197,139,.04) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(25,197,139,.04) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:46px 46px;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#000,transparent 85%)}
.ga-page .ga-activities .ga-heading-stack{margin-bottom:55px}.ga-page .ga-activity-layout{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.07fr) minmax(0,.93fr);gap:clamp(38px,7vw,110px);align-items:center}.ga-page .ga-activity-list{position:relative;gap:0}.ga-page .ga-activity{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:62px minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:22px;padding:25px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(170,229,199,.16);transition:border-color .3s,transform .4s var(--ease)}
.ga-page .ga-activity:first-child{border-top:1px solid rgba(170,229,199,.16)}.ga-page .ga-activity:hover,.ga-page .ga-activity:focus-within,.ga-page .ga-activity.ga-active{border-color:rgba(163,244,81,.65)}.ga-page .ga-activity:hover,.ga-page .ga-activity:focus-within{transform:translateX(-6px)}
.ga-page .ga-activity-mark{grid-row:1 / span 3;width:58px;height:58px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(25,197,139,.52);background:rgba(11,68,53,.65);box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px rgba(25,197,139,.08);transition:border-color .35s,box-shadow .35s}.ga-page .ga-activity-mark svg{width:28px;height:28px;stroke:#a3f451;stroke-width:1.5;fill:none;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round}.ga-page :is(.ga-activity:hover,.ga-activity.ga-active) .ga-activity-mark{border-color:#a3f451;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(163,244,81,.22)}
.ga-page .ga-activity .ga-h3,.ga-page .ga-activity .ga-body{grid-column:2}.ga-page .ga-activity .ga-h3{margin-bottom:5px}.ga-page .ga-activity .ga-body .elementor-heading-title{font-size:14px;line-height:2.05}.ga-page .ga-activity-art{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:540px;justify-self:center;aspect-ratio:1}.ga-page .ga-activity-art svg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}.ga-page .ga-core-ring{transform-origin:300px 300px;transform-box:view-box}
/* Experience: the numeral is real text and always says the supplied ۱۰+, never a fake counter. */
.ga-page .ga-experience{background:#fff}.ga-page .ga-experience-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.95fr);gap:clamp(40px,7vw,100px);align-items:center}.ga-page .ga-experience-copy{gap:20px}.ga-page .ga-experience-copy .ga-body{max-width:610px}
.ga-page .ga-experience-trail{display:flex;flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 24px;margin-top:12px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid rgba(11,68,53,.14)}.ga-page .ga-experience-trail .elementor-heading-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;color:#0b6047;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}.ga-page .ga-experience-trail .elementor-heading-title::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#19c58b}
.ga-page .ga-exp-art{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:550px;justify-self:center;aspect-ratio:1.13;background:radial-gradient(circle at center,rgba(25,197,139,.16),transparent 52%),#06271f;overflow:hidden}.ga-page .ga-exp-art::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(25,197,139,.3) .8px,transparent .8px);background-size:22px 22px;opacity:.4}.ga-page .ga-exp-art svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}.ga-page .ga-number{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#a3f451;font-size:clamp(100px,12vw,168px);font-weight:900;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.06em;text-shadow:0 0 35px rgba(163,244,81,.25);direction:rtl}
/* Mission: a single uninterrupted three-stop line. */
.ga-page .ga-mission{background:#f0fbf6}.ga-page .ga-mission-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.85fr);gap:40px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:62px}.ga-page .ga-mission-intro .elementor-heading-title{color:#426158;font-size:15px}.ga-page .ga-mission-track{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:clamp(24px,4vw,62px)}
.ga-page .ga-mission-track::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:32px;right:35px;left:35px;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(25,197,139,.25),#19c58b,rgba(25,197,139,.25))}.ga-page .ga-mission-item{position:relative;gap:15px}.ga-page .ga-mission-mark{position:relative;z-index:1;display:grid;place-items:center;width:66px;height:66px;margin-bottom:13px;border:1px solid #19c58b;border-radius:50%;background:#f0fbf6;box-shadow:0 0 0 9px #f0fbf6;transition:background .3s,box-shadow .3s}.ga-page .ga-mission-mark svg{width:27px;height:27px;stroke:#0b6047;fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.ga-page .ga-mission-item:hover .ga-mission-mark{background:#d6f7df;box-shadow:0 0 0 9px #f0fbf6,0 0 25px rgba(25,197,139,.3)}
/* Values as a connected rail and an illuminated engineering diagram, not cards. */
.ga-page .ga-why{background:#fff}.ga-page .ga-why-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,.85fr);gap:clamp(45px,8vw,120px);align-items:center}.ga-page .ga-why-copy{gap:28px}.ga-page .ga-reasons{gap:0}.ga-page .ga-reason{display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:18px;padding:18px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(6,39,31,.13);transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s}.ga-page .ga-reason:first-child{border-top:1px solid rgba(6,39,31,.13)}.ga-page .ga-reason:hover{transform:translateX(-6px);border-color:#19c58b}.ga-page .ga-reason .ga-reason-number{flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid rgba(11,68,53,.2);border-radius:50%;color:#087653;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;direction:rtl}.ga-page .ga-reason .ga-h3 .elementor-heading-title{font-size:16px}.ga-page .ga-why-art{width:100%;max-width:490px;justify-self:center;aspect-ratio:1}.ga-page .ga-why-art svg{width:100%;height:100%}
/* Vision and a concluding circuit, not stock photography. */
.ga-page .ga-vision{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 22% 70%,rgba(25,197,139,.25),transparent 48%),#06271f;color:#fff}.ga-page .ga-vision-layout{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(30px,5vw,80px);align-items:center}.ga-page .ga-vision-copy{gap:20px}.ga-page .ga-vision-art{width:100%;max-width:600px;justify-self:center;aspect-ratio:1.15}.ga-page .ga-vision-art svg{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.ga-page .ga-final{background:#f0fbf6}.ga-page .ga-final-panel{position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:35px;padding:clamp(34px,5vw,70px);border:1px solid rgba(25,197,139,.45);background:radial-gradient(circle at 5% 110%,rgba(25,197,139,.24),transparent 45%),#0b4435;color:#fff}.ga-page .ga-final-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-110px;top:-180px;width:390px;height:390px;border:1px solid rgba(163,244,81,.22);border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 30px rgba(25,197,139,.035),0 0 0 65px rgba(25,197,139,.035);pointer-events:none}.ga-page .ga-final-copy{position:relative;gap:16px;max-width:660px}.ga-page .ga-final-actions{position:relative;align-items:stretch;gap:10px;flex:none;width:max-content;max-width:100%}.ga-page .ga-final-actions .elementor-button{width:100%;min-width:230px}
/* Motion uses compositor transforms, a handful of traveling path points, and IO-gated reveals. */
@keyframes ga-spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes ga-spin-reverse{to{transform:rotate(-360deg)}}@keyframes ga-route{from{offset-distance:0%}to{offset-distance:100%}}@keyframes ga-draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}@keyframes ga-fade-up{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}@keyframes ga-breathe{0%,100%{opacity:.65}50%{opacity:1}}@keyframes ga-number-rise{from{opacity:.1;transform:scale(.8);filter:blur(5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1);filter:blur(0)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){
 .ga-page.ga-motion .ga-ring-one,.ga-page.ga-motion .ga-core-ring{animation:ga-spin 38s linear infinite}.ga-page.ga-motion .ga-ring-two{animation:ga-spin-reverse 27s linear infinite}.ga-page.ga-motion .ga-ring-three{animation:ga-spin 55s linear infinite}.ga-page.ga-motion .ga-pulse{animation:ga-route var(--duration,6s) linear infinite}.ga-page.ga-motion .ga-orbit-light{animation:ga-breathe 3.8s ease-in-out infinite}
